cases.dependencies: Size of the real threaded mounting pads. None omits pads while allowing separately configured mounting holes. The margin must fit the thread diameter plus 4 mm.
Pad and mounting-boss height above the plate. When printed upside down, the original engine uses threaded holes instead of raised pads.
Radial thread fit allowance. A 0.2 mm radial allowance changes the mating diameter by 0.4 mm; this differs from ordinary-hole diametral clearance.
Add intermediate pads along edges longer than this distance. Zero leaves the corner pads without this additional spacing rule.

warnings: 4 seam(s) crossing the frame have no clear spot for a joiner plate

cases.dependencies: Select the screw size for mounting holes and their specialized joiner/extender plates. None omits mounting holes.
Cut real threads in mounting holes instead of plain clearance holes.
Diametral hole allowance, added to the nominal screw diameter. For threaded holes the engine converts this to a radial thread allowance.
Distance between mounting holes along the frame band. Zero omits regularly spaced extra holes; seam joining can still place required holes.
Distance of mounting holes from either side of a seam. The engine moves colliding positions or refuses an impossible layout.
Distance between the two rows of an extender plate, not the outer plate length.
Round and thread detail. Higher values increase the actual STL triangle count and processing cost.
Physical width added around the assembled stencil in each ring. Every slab must retain a screw hole.
Number of nested border rings. Each wraps the previous ring and has its own numbered slabs.
Maximum border slab length. The engine keeps corner pieces and requires a mounting hole in every slab.
Total fit gap between slabs and between the border and plate. The engine offsets slab edges while keeping joint hole positions fixed.
Thickness of the specialized border joiner plates.
Include the actual threaded bolt and nut models required for border joints. When off, supply suitable fasteners separately.
Bolt length in millimetres. Zero calculates enough length for joiner, slab and nut.
Radial female-thread allowance for the nut. Physical calibration is still required for your printer and material.
Radial narrowing at the bolt tip; zero keeps a plain end.
Length of the bolt-tip narrowing in thread pitches. Used only when tip taper is above zero.
Cut a number into each slab. Its number matches the engine’s slab order and assembly file.
Size of the recessed slab number. If there is no safe position, the engine reports the unnumbered slab.
Depth of the number pocket. Zero uses one source print layer; the cut must leave material below it.
Add outer-ring wall mounting holes, because the original plate holes are now used by the border joints.
Spacing of wall mounting holes on the outer ring. Applies when wall holes are enabled.
Round and thread detail for border holes and accompanying hardware.
Distance between the rows of the four-hole hand-sized plate and any extender matched to connected mounting parts.
Thickness of joiners matched to a connected mounting assembly. Hand-sized plates have their own independent thickness.
Include independently sized two-hole and four-hole plates, alongside the screw and nut.
Centre-to-centre distance between the two holes in the hand-sized plate.
Thickness of the hand-sized plates in millimetres.
Material padding around the holes and rounded plate ends.
Cut real female threads in the hand-sized plates instead of plain clearance holes.
Diametral allowance for the hand-sized plate holes; the engine halves it when constructing female threads.
Metric screw size. M3, M4, M5, M6, M8 and M10 use the original real-thread generator.
Threaded bolt length in millimetres, excluding its head.
Radial female-thread allowance in the nut. Test the printed fit before committing a complete assembly.
Radial bolt-tip narrowing. Zero keeps the nominal thread through the tip.
Length of tip narrowing in thread pitches; inactive when taper is zero.
Generate the real connector calibration strip, with holes of increasing clearance. Use the matching nominal tile connector rod for physical calibration. Every file is still independently checked.
Shape of the calibration strip holes and matching connector rod.
Nominal calibration connector diameter. This is separate from the metric screw size.
Round and thread detail in the generated meshes. Higher detail uses more memory and time.
